content: AudioBufferSourceNode is one-shot: create a fresh node via ctx.createBufferSource() for every playback, reusing the same decoded AudioBuffer (no re-fetch/re-decode needed per tap). Source nodes are cheap/optimized for this create-per-play pattern, enabling rapid repeated or overlapping playback without the HTMLAudioElement replay-delay bug. Sources: MDN AudioBufferSourceNode/createBufferSource docs, Chrome Web Audio FAQ, webaudioapi.com book.
